articles.title: U.S. Justice Department assembles force to shield against foreign AI threats
articles.description: The new DOJ task force will aid the recently designated U.S. "SI Force" by warding off bad actors backed by other nations, criminal groups or corporate fraud.

articles.title: Bitcion tumbles to $76,000 as collapsing AI trade drags stocks sharply lower
articles.description: The post-election rally quickly reversed as AI stocks plunged, but cryptocurrencies held up relatively better despite a $1 billion liquidation wave.

articles.title: What is TraderTraitor, the hacking squad behind the $6.3 billion Binance heist?
articles.description: The hacking group has been behind some of the crypto industry's most recent high-profile thefts.

articles.title: Standard Chartered and SBI back crypto insurer Soter as funding reaches $23.5 million
articles.description: Soter also received backing of 500 BTC and 2000 ETH, worth another $43 million at current prices.

articles.title: Crypto for Advisors: Where investors stake crypto shapes how much of the reward they keep
Gate CEO says crypto exchanges must prove they can survive a hack like Binance’s
articles.description: Lin Han says Gate holds enough assets in cold storage to cover customer balances even if its hot wallets are emptied. An independent audit is underway.

articles.title: Kraken parent Payward and its clients buy AAVE tokens in DeFi investment push
articles.description: The investment follows talks first reported by CoinDesk in June that included a proposed equity stake in Aave Group.

articles.title: Google could take stake in bitcoin miner TeraWulf’s $19 billion AI project if Anthropic defaults
articles.description: A $19 billion data-center agreement includes an unusual provision allowing Google to acquire part of the project if Anthropic fails to pay its rent.

articles.title: Binance cuts SignalPlus access after security warning, urges users to check accounts
articles.description: The exchange says its systems are unaffected but has removed trading connections to the third-party platform as a precaution.

articles.title: Ukraine’s central bank opposes crypto bill, citing monetary sovereignty concerns
articles.description: Ukraine’s central bank won’t back a crypto legalization bill in its current form and wants lawmakers to revise it before a final vote.

articles.title: Bitcoin is resilient, but leverage is missing and demand still tepid
articles.description: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 5, 2026

articles.title: Bitcoin miners are oversold following 35% October rout, VanEck says
articles.description: Investors dumped AI infrastructure providers across the board in October, treating companies in very different sectors as one monolithic trade.

articles.title: Trump-linked American Bitcoin swings to $126 million profit but misses revenue estimates
articles.description: Revenue fell to $63.4 million in the third quarter and missed analysts’ forecasts as bitcoin production declined and higher summer electricity prices pushed mining costs up.

articles.title: Bitcoin holds above $80,000 after Wednesday’s jump as injective rallies on staked ETF listing
articles.description: Bitcoin slipped 0.2% to around $80,250 since midnight UTC, holding above $80,000 after Wednesday’s jump, as spot ETFs ended a three-day outflow streak.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin drops more than 5% as stocks close out worst day since April 2025
articles.description: The continued blowup of the AI trade led markets lower, with Nvidia losing 9.3% and many other chip names down double-digit percentages.

articles.title: Mercado Bitcoin hack continued hours after exchange said attack was contained, report finds
articles.description: The same attacker took about $391,000, mostly from wallets Bitquery ties to BitMart, whose founder confirmed a Nov. 2 hack and suspects a link.

articles.title: Bitcoin miner Riot could pay Anthropic 12% interest under $28 billion AI deal
articles.description: Riot has sold most of its bitcoin to fund its move into data centers. Its latest agreement gives Anthropic a way to finance part of the build and collect interest through rent deductions.

articles.title: Hong Kong passes law requiring crypto exchanges to report customer transactions to tax authorities
articles.description: Crypto firms must collect customer and transaction data from 2027, with Hong Kong sharing the information with overseas tax authorities from 2028.

articles.title: OpenAI says its AI can break into Linux at scale. Here's what it means for crypto
articles.description: OpenAI says its AI found 948 Linux flaws and wrote a working attack for each one. Crypto security voices say decentralization leaves the industry better placed than most to cope.

articles.title: Zcash is about to freeze $16 million in its oldest privacy pool
articles.description: About 12,200 ZEC remains in Sprout, the privacy pool Zcash launched in 2016. Roughly 10,000 coins have left over the past week, but only about 40 moved out Wednesday.

articles.title: The pile of lawsuits against Kalshi just grew by one
articles.description: Arkansas has accused the prediction market of running illegal gambling, joining Utah and several other U.S. states that have filed criminal or civil charges.

articles.title: XRP Ledger fixes a disclosed bug that could have led to the creation of new tokens
articles.description: The fix went live Wednesday after validator support reset the activation clock in October. XRP itself was unaffected.

articles.title: Bitcoin holds above $80,000 as Zcash jumps 12% in post-election crypto rebound
articles.description: Ether rose 8% as falling oil prices and a weaker dollar helped markets recover, even as traders weighed a tougher path for U.S. crypto legislation.

articles.title: Trump Media moves $342 million in bitcoin to Crypto.com, blockchain data show
articles.description: A wallet supposedly linked to Trump Media has made a large BTC transfer to Crypto.com, data tracked by Arkham show.

articles.title: Tokenization and stablecoins may weather Democrats' sweep as broader crypto rules face uncertainty
articles.description: Wall Street's push to bring finance onto blockchain rails may continue under existing laws, though the SEC and CFTC face tougher oversight and questions over how long their rules will last, experts said.
